mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, contract_id AS contractId, sequence, due_date AS dueDate, principal_due AS principalDue, interest_due AS interestDue, total_payment_due AS totalPaymentDue, remaining_principal AS remainingPrincipal, status, paid_at AS paidAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM repayment_schedule WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY sequence ASC

SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, contract_id AS contractId, sequence, due_date AS dueDate, principal_due AS principalDue, interest_due AS interestDue, total_payment_due AS totalPaymentDue, remaining_principal AS remainingPrincipal, status, paid_at AS paidAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM repayment_schedule WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, contract_id AS contractId, sequence AS sequence, due_date AS dueDate, principal_due AS principalDue, interest_due AS interestDue, total_payment_due AS totalPaymentDue, remaining_principal AS remainingPrincipal, status AS status, paid_at AS paidAt FROM repayment_schedule WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
